Collections make it easy to keep track of favorite add-ons and share your perfectly customized browser with others. This article describes how to create, edit, share, and delete a collection on addons.mozilla.org. 

__TOC__

In order to use collections, you need to register for a Mozilla account or sign in to addons.mozilla.org using your Mozilla account credentials. 

=Create a collection=
#Once you are signed in to addons.mozilla.org, click on your name in the upper right hand corner of the screen and select {menu View My Collections} from the popup menu.
#;[[Image:view selections addons]]
#On the next screen, click the button that says {button Create a Collection} to create a collection. 
#;[[Image:create collection addon]]
#On the next screen, you can give your collection a name and a description. Note that all collections are public and can be viewed by anyone with a link to the collection. When you are done, click {button Create collection}.
#;[[Image:create collection detail]]
#Type the name of the extension or theme you want to add into the search box and select it from the list.
#;[[Image:search addon collection]]
#Once you select the extension from the list, addons.mozilla.org will automatically save your collection. You can add a note about the extension or theme if you would like, or click the {button Remove} button to remove it from the collection.
#;[[Image:save addon collection]]

=Edit a collection=
#Once you are signed in to addons.mozilla.org, click on your name in the upper right hand corner of screen and select {menu View My Collections} from the popup menu.
#Click the collection you'd like to edit.
#Click the {button Edit this Collection}.
#;[[Image:edit this collection]]
#You can add or remove extensions and themes. Those changes will be automatically saved. 
#To edit general information about the collection, click the {button Edit collection details} button. '''Note:''' you will need to save changes if you edit general information. 
#;[[Image:edit this collection]]
#;[[Image:edit collection details]]

=Share a collection=
Your collection will have a URL that you can share with others.
;[[Image:collection url]]

=Delete a collection=
#Once you are signed in to addons.mozilla.org, click on your name in the upper right hand corner of the screen and select {menu View My Collections} from the popup menu.
#Click {button Delete this collection} on the left side of the screen. 
#Select confirm. Your collection will then be deleted.
